description: This is a Java unit test class for MongoQueryBuilder, specifically testing its behavior with unlimited query configurations.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderUnlimitedTest
classes.description: Unit test suite verifying behavior of MongoQueryBuilder when configured with unlimited (or specific) query parameters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up mock criteria and a MongoQueryBuilder instance before each test.

methods.name: createWithNullCriteria
methods.description: Verifies that constructing MongoQueryBuilder with null criteria throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildWithCriteriaOnly
methods.description: Tests building a query with only criteria set.

methods.name: buildWithSort
methods.description: Tests setting sort options and building the query.

methods.name: buildWithLimit
methods.description: Tests setting a limit and building the query.

methods.name: buildWithSkip
methods.description: Tests setting skip (offset) and building the query.

methods.name: buildWithVeryHighLimit
methods.description: Tests setting a very high limit value.

methods.name: buildWithLimitLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative limit throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithSkipLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative skip throws IllegalArgumentException.
